title: Qujingtai · Collect inspiration, organize your day
description: A photography workspace for inspiration, shoot plans and everyday scheduling.
eyebrow: A calmer beginning for every creative idea
intro: Bring the images you love, the shoots you imagine and your everyday schedule into one workspace. From a fleeting idea to your next shutter release.
shootNote: Collect references and note down ideas
sectionLabel: A place for ideas. A place for everyday work.
sectionTitle: Keep ideas together. See what is next.
sectionIntro: Find your own rhythm in the small details of photography work.
detail1: Save reference images, organize themes with tags and revisit images and colors.
detail2: Bring reference images, text and attachments together as your idea takes shape.
detail3: Organize your shoots and connect your public availability with bookings.
detail4: Keep track of plans and check updates and reminders in the message center.
detail5: Record daily income and expenses and review your photography finances.
detail6: Read notifications in one place and optionally connect WeCom, DingTalk or Feishu bots.
flowTitle: Give a good idea a next step.

a1: Photography enthusiasts and working photographers who want one place for references, shoot plans and everyday arrangements.
